title: Heroes Script
features:
⚔️ Main Features
• Anti-Screen Effects (hides annoying transitions)
• Anti-Telekinesis (prevents yourself from getting grabbed)
• Auto Chests (automatically collect all spawned in chests)
• Flight Speed (raise the flight speed cap)
• No Flight Cooldown (self-explanatory)

👁️ Awareness
• Player ESP (displays player names, character names, distance, health)
• Render Distance Adjuster (how far you want to see players)
• Quest ESP (self-explanatory)
• All Players / ESP Player Selector

⚡ Automation
• Outspammer (outspam targets insanely fast, beats any autoclicker)

🎯 Auto Respawn
• Character (choose which character to instantly spawn as if not taken)

🔥 Waypoints
• Destination (a list of locations ingame you can teleport to)

🎨 Visual Features
• Name Changer (change characters username)
• Colour Tag (rainbow, pink or VIP tag for free)
• Own All Characters (visual)

🌥️ Ambience
• Time of Day (self-explanatory)
• Fullbright (removes shadows & makes it day forever)

📊 Players Information Stats
• Username
• Character

⚙️ Essentials & Settings
• FPS Booster (boosts your performance)
• Rejoin Server
• Remove Map Borders
• Custom Cursor
• Show Watermark (FPS & Ping Display)
• Menu Keybind
• Unload Script (Disables and cleans up everything)

💾 Configuration & Customization
• Auto-Save: Configs save automatically for your next rejoin
• Config Sharing: Share your profiles with friends
• Themes & Fonts: Full UI color styling & custom font selection
• Background Image: Add your own background image to the GUI
